title: [GMCP 203.009.03] Integration: Complete tool server surface
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-009-03. Wire the capability through every applicable server, client, host, gateway, SDK, CLI, configuration, callback, supervisor, persistence, and migration surface. Prove that direct, daemon, and gateway entry points share the same implementation and policy boundaries. Vector outcome: Tool discovery, deterministic pagination/filtering, list-change signaling, invocation, structured and unstructured results, output-schema validation, annotations, icons, errors, cancellation, progress, caching, idempotency declarations, and concurrent execution all work through the production registry. Tool identity and schema changes are versioned, calls are policy-gated, and success is impossible when declared output contracts are violated. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
